matches.title: Los Angeles Kings × Florida Panthers
analysis: Los Angeles have yet to win: they lost 8–4 to Colorado and 5–4 to San Jose in overtime. Despite scoring eight goals, they conceded thirteen in just two games. Florida started with one win and two overtime defeats, scoring six and conceding seven. All three of their games were decided beyond regulation time.

Last season, the Kings won fifteen of their 41 home games, averaging 2.59 goals scored and 3.02 allowed. Florida won seventeen road games, averaging 2.85 scored and 3.71 allowed. The Panthers won both head-to-head meetings that season, totalling eight goals to the Kings' four. The rematch sees Los Angeles looking to correct a vulnerable defensive start, while Florida aims to turn close games into wins.
